What on Earth is a Black Market?

The black market is an unofficial (illegal) market. It is not a real place, just a name to represent that you bought something without the government knowledge. Black markets flourishes in corrupt countries.

If you ever bought something for a lower price from a shop without receipt or hired a worker to do things in your home but did not pay official taxes, then you are too on the black market.

Things along those lines do exist in rough cities. Want some cheap, stolen watches and bootleg DVDs? That's where you go.

Otherwise it's just a general term for goods in the underground economy.

Is there a reason why you build everything in one go?

You could start with a big case and a powerful power supply and enough cooling power. Then build the old machine in that new case.

This way your computer becomes incremental more powerful and stays up to date when you replace the components. Over the next years you computer will be cheaper and more powerful than if you buy it all in one go.

  • When you buy it now then you burn all your money and have one very fast computer right now but it will be bypassed in 6 months from now.
  • When you start with the case, power supply and cooling, then you spend less money, and can wait for the next gen graphics card to come out. This way you don't have a graphics card that is already 6 months on the market but a brand generation new one.
